explanation: Pelé was 17 when he scored twice in the 1958 final against the hosts, Sweden. Garrincha, his Brazil teammate, won in 1958 and 1962 but missed the 1970 tournament.

claims.text: Pelé won the men's World Cup with Brazil in 1958, 1962 and 1970.
Garrincha won the World Cup in 1958 and 1962 only, Diego Maradona in 1986 only, and Franz Beckenbauer as a player in 1974 only.
Pelé was 17 when he scored twice in the 1958 final, which Brazil won 5-2 against the hosts, Sweden.
Garrincha was not in Brazil's squad at the 1970 World Cup.
